## Oak Seedlings Project

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

library(googlesheets4)

Height_Data_Raw <- read_sheet("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/19MYOMFHIG1VxHvqBHCDd6DUvH_IJGpFXzwnos60RWtY/edit?gid=472361920#gid=472361920", sheet = "Seedling Heights")

LICOR_Data_Raw <- read_sheet("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/19MYOMFHIG1VxHvqBHCDd6DUvH_IJGpFXzwnos60RWtY/edit?gid=472361920#gid=472361920", sheet = "LICOR")

Moist_Data_Raw <- read_sheet("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/19MYOMFHIG1VxHvqBHCDd6DUvH_IJGpFXzwnos60RWtY/edit?gid=472361920#gid=472361920", sheet = "Soil Moisture",na = "NA" )

SPAD_Data_Raw <- read_sheet("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/19MYOMFHIG1VxHvqBHCDd6DUvH_IJGpFXzwnos60RWtY/edit?gid=472361920#gid=472361920", sheet = "SPAD", na = "NA")
```

## Height

```{r}
Height_Data_Clean <- 
  Height_Data_Raw |> 
  select(Date, Block, Tag_Num, Treatment, Sapling_AB_etc, Seedling_Ht_cm, Dead_Alive ) |> 
  filter(Dead_Alive == "Alive", Treatment != "NR")


Height_Data_Clean |> group_by(Block, Treatment) |> count()

Height_Data_Clean |> group_by(Treatment) |> count()


Height_Data_Clean |> ggplot(aes(x = Block, fill = Treatment)) + geom_bar()


Height_Data_Clean |> ggplot(aes(x = Treatment, y = Seedling_Ht_cm)) + geom_boxplot()


Height_model <- lm(Seedling_Ht_cm ~ Treatment +Block, data = Height_Data_Clean)

anova(Height_model)
```

## Moisture

Why is there moisture data taken for Natural Recruits? WTF is that?

```{r}
Moist_Data_Clean <- Moist_Data_Raw |> 
  mutate(VWC_mean = (VWC1_perc + VWC2_perc + VWC3_perc)/3,
         PER_mean = (PER1_ms + PER2_ms + PER3_ms)/3,
         VWC_mean = case_when(
           is.na(VWC_mean) == TRUE ~ VWC1_perc,
           TRUE ~ VWC_mean),
         PER_mean = case_when(
           is.na(PER_mean) == TRUE ~ PER1_ms, 
           TRUE ~ PER_mean
         )) |> 
  drop_na(VWC_mean) |> 
  select(Date, Block, Treatment, VWC_mean, PER_mean)

Moist_Data_Clean |> ggplot(aes(x = Treatment)) + geom_bar()

Moist_Data_Clean |> ggplot(aes(x = Treatment, y = VWC_mean)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "col") + 
  stat_summary(fun.x = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2)
```

## SPAD

```{r}
SPAD_Data_Clean <- SPAD_Data_Raw |> 
  filter(Dead_Alive == "Alive") |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(SPAD_mean = mean(c_across(8:13), na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  select(Date, Block, Treatment, Tag_Num, SPAD_mean)

SPAD_Data_Clean |> ggplot(aes(x = Treatment, y = SPAD_mean)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "col") + 
  stat_summary(fun.x = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2)

SPAD_model <- lm(SPAD_mean ~ Treatment + Block, data = SPAD_Data_Clean)

anova(SPAD_model)
```
